question: The 40th Indian site to be inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List is located in the state of ________.
solution:
The Correct answer is **__Gujarat__. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** 40th Indian point **to be inscribed on the **UNESCO World Heritage List is located in Gujarat. **
 
• India's name of **Dholavira**, the **Harappan City in the Rann of Kutch, Gujarat **has been named on **UNESCO's World Heritage list. **
 
• After the addition of the two spots, the number of **World Heritage spots** in **India** stands to be 40. 
 
• While **Dholavira** came to the fourth point from **Gujarat and 40th from India** to make the list, it's the first point of the **ancient Indus Valley Civilisation( IVC)** in India to get the label. 
 
• In total, there are **121 monuments** listed in **UNESCO spots**, across **167 countries.**
 
• The oldest point of the **Indus Valley Civilization, Bhirrana,** and the largest point** Rakhigarhi are located in the Indian state of Haryana. **
 
• Further, 90 of the inscribed objects and seals discovered were set up at ancient civic centres along the Indus swash in Pakistan, substantially Harappa( Punjab) and Mohenjo- Daro( Sindh). 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Dholavira **is an archaeological point at** Khadirbet in Bhachau Taluka of Kutch District**, in the state of **Gujarat** in **western India.**
 
• Also known locally as **Kotada timba**, the point contains remains of a megacity of the ancient **Indus Valley civilization. **
 
• **Dholavira’s** position is on the **Tropic of Cancer**. 
 
• It's one of the five** largest Harappan spots** and the most prominent of archaeological spots in India belonging to the **Indus Valley Civilization. **
 
• The point was" officially" **discovered in 1967- 68 **by** J.P. Joshi,** one of the **Archaeological Survey of India( ASI).** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **UNESCO United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization.** The **United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization( UNESCO)** was established** on 16 November 1945. **
 
• UNESCO has** 195 Members** and **8 Associate Members** and is **controlled by the General Conference and the Executive Board.** 
 
• A **World Heritage Site **is a corner or area with legal protection by a transnational convention administered by the** United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization( UNESCO). **
 
• **World Heritage spots are designated by UNESCO for having artistic, literal, scientific, or other forms of significance.** 
 
• A**ux Meadows National Historic Park, was the first UNESCO world heritage point**__. 
 
• The **“ World Heritage Convention ”** classifies the world heritage of humankind into two orders,'** artistic heritage**' and' **natural** **heritage'**, easily indicated in the title of the convention.
